title: Google segmentation failures
intro: Crops exactly as Document AI cut them. Measured: neighbouring-line ink on 27–46 of 100 cards on the Gazette, Kosmopolis and Lekythos originals (2–4 after masking); merged lines 8%, 18%, 12% of their candidate rows; rotated verticals 2.9% of Gazette modern rows and 20% of its headings; in E3 2.8% of test lines had a 3+ atom length mismatch and carried 44% of all edits; about 19% of printed rows get no Google box at all (SG2 strips below show admission loss; raw Google boxes exist on these witnesses).

groups.heading: Two or more lines in one crop, label covers one  (8 of 1,400 C1 cards)
Crop shorter than the printed line  (4 of 1,400 C1 cards)
Neighbouring line ink inside the crop  (154 of 1,400 C1 cards)
Crop spans two table columns  (1 of 1,400 C1 cards)
Clipped at the edge  (14 of 1,400 C1 cards)
Vertical line stored rotated  (2.9% of Gazette modern rows, 20% of its headings)
SG2: printed rows with no admitted box (3 strip witnesses)
groups.header: Blue: admitted boxes; cyan: other raw Google boxes; red: no admitted box. These witnesses have raw boxes.
